title: Toward Fine-Grained Forgetting:Attribute Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.01008v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can memorize and disclose sensitive information, motivating machine unlearning to remove designated knowledge while preserving model utility. Existing privacy-oriented benchmarks mainly study profile-level deletion, whereas practical requests often require finer-grained forgetting: removing a sensitive attribute while retaining other information about the same identity. We introduce attribute-level MLLM unlearning and construct AMU-Bench, covering long-text, numeric, and short-text targets, multiple forget ratios, and diverse question types. Our evaluation shows that target and retain attributes share identity-specific and visual evidence, making selective forgetting prone to residual leakage and collateral degradation. translated_title: 迈向细粒度遗忘：多模态大语言模型的属性遗忘
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够记忆并泄露敏感信息，这推动了机器遗忘技术的发展，以在保持模型效用的同时删除指定知识。现有的面向隐私的基准主要研究档案级别的删除，而实际需求往往需要更细粒度的遗忘：在保留同一身份其他信息的同时删除某个敏感属性。我们提出了属性级别的多模态大语言模型遗忘任务，并构建了AMU-Bench基准，涵盖长文本、数字和短文本目标、多种遗忘比例以及多样化的问题类型。我们的评估表明，目标属性和保留属性共享身份特定信息与视觉证据，使得选择性遗忘容易出现残留泄露和附带性能退化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了因果定位与保留感知投影（CLRP），这是一个轻量级、无需训练的框架，能够定位因果相关的层并……
tldr: 该论文提出多模态大语言模型的属性级遗忘任务并构建AMU-Bench基准，发现选择性删除敏感属性易导致残留泄露与性能退化，进而提出无需训练的轻量级框架CLRP，通过因果定位与保留感知投影实现细粒度的精准遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces attribute-level unlearning for multimodal large language models with the AMU-Bench benchmark, reveals that selective forgetting suffers from residual leakage and collateral degradation, and proposes CLRP, a lightweight training-free framework using causal localization and retain-aware projection for fine-grained forgetting.
